name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bigbuy-mcp
description: BigBuy (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order, track. Every

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BigBuy API key from the control panel (API access is part of BigBuy's paid packs), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (JWT bearer scheme in the OpenAPI spec). Sandbox keys need base https://api.sandbox.bigbuy.eu, which this server does not switch to.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_ISO_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter language for product texts and tracking descriptions (the `isoCode` query parameter, e.g. en); BigBuy defaults to es when unset.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGBUY_PAYMENT_METHOD
environmentVariables.description: paymentMethod for create_order: paypal, moneybox (prepaid purse, see GET /rest/user/purse) or bankwire; left out of the body when unset.
